sloka: ईप्सितं तस्य विज्ञाय देवी सुरुचिरानना ।प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यमेवमेव भविष्यति ।। ७.८७.२७ ॥
transliteration: īpsitaṁ tasya vijñāya devī surucirānanā ।pratyuvāca śubhaṁ vākyamevameva bhaviṣyati ।। 7.87.27 ॥

translations.english: Understanding his wish, the Goddess with a very beautiful face replied with auspicious words, saying, 'It shall be exactly so.'
